newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH TRADE LOBBY UPS 1996 SALES GROWTH FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH TRADE LOBBY UPS 1996 SALES GROWTH FORECAST.

text.p: The Federation of Commerce and Trade (KKL) raised its forecast for the increase in value of 1996 retail sales to four percent from three after a 3.7 percent rise in first-half sales, KKL said in a statement on Wednesday.
KKL also raised its forecast for the increase in value of wholesales in 1996 to four percent from three percent after a 3.8 percent rise in sales in January-June.
In full-year 1995, the value of KKL members' retail sales rose 3.6 percent and the value of wholesales rose 6.2 percent.
In retailing, car sales rose over 20 percent in the firs-half this year. The value of grocery sales increased two percent in H1 as prices kept falling further.
Alcoholic beverages sales fell 40 percent due to growing tourism-linked imports from nearby regions.
Hardware retail sales fell two percent in H1, but there was a pick-up in sales in May, KKL said.
In wholesales, technical goods sales fell 4.4 percent, which was mostly due to a weak development in chemical goods sales. Consumer goods demand was also still subdued.
